# Aggelos Mouzakitis

> BACP-registered psychotherapist and high-performance coach for founders, executives, and senior tech operators. Based in Ireland, working globally. 18+ years in B2B SaaS growth.

Aggelos Mouzakitis helps tech high performers break the deeper patterns behind burnout, shame-driven achievement, overthinking, and emotional fatigue — through high-trust advisory, nervous system regulation, and data from wearables. He is a licensed psychotherapist registered with the British Association for Counselling and Psychotherapy (BACP) and holds 18+ years of experience in B2B SaaS growth, having led growth strategy at early-stage startups and IBM's enterprise portfolio and advised 50+ companies.

His work addresses why high performers feel stuck despite strong results: achievement has often quietly become the way they regulate their sense of worth. The goal is to keep the ambition while ending the dependence underneath it — so success feels worth it again.

## Services

- [Therapy for Executives](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/therapy-for-executives/): Psychotherapy for executives and senior leaders in tech who've done everything right and still feel something is off. Addresses identity enmeshment with performance, isolation that comes with seniority, strategic fatigue, and patterns that coaching alone can't reach.
- [Therapy for Founders](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/therapy-for-founders/): For founders carrying what they can't say out loud — the isolation, identity loss after exit, investor pressure, existential doubt, and the question of who they are when the company isn't doing well.
- [Imposter Syndrome Coaching](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/imposter-syndrome-therapy/): For senior tech professionals dealing with shame-driven achievement and chronic self-doubt. The doubt is real; the story it tells you isn't.
- [Executive Burnout Coaching](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/executive-burnout-therapy/): For high-functioning burnout that rest doesn't fix — rooted in identity patterns and nervous system dysregulation, not just overwork.
- [Career Transition Coaching](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/career-transition-therapy/): For senior professionals navigating a working life that no longer feels genuinely fulfilling — toward clarity, not just another impressive move.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/blog/): Essays on high-functioning burnout, performance identity, the psychology of ambition, imposter syndrome, shame-driven achievement, and the cost of success. Published weekly.

## Tools

- [High-Performance Fulfilment Diagnostic](https://aggelosmouzakitis.com/burnout-diagnostic/): Free 45-question diagnostic for tech high performers — maps pressure, achievement patterns, nervous system load, meaning, and recovery. Takes approximately 8 minutes.
